passage.label: Sulayman given to Dawud as an excellent servant repeatedly turning back; racehorses exhibited in the afternoon; his preference for love of good things over remembrance until the sun vanished behind the curtain; order to return them and striking of legs and necks; trial by a body placed on his throne and his return; supplication for forgiveness and a kingdom belonging to none after him; wind subjected blowing gently by his command wherever he directed; devils as builders and divers with others bound in shackles; the gift to grant or withhold without account; nearness and good return; Ayyub calling that Satan touched him with hardship and torment; the command to strike with his foot producing a cool bath and drink; family restored with a like number as mercy and reminder; the bunch of grass to strike with without breaking the oath, found patient and excellent; Ibrahim, Ishaq and Yaqub as possessors of strength and vision chosen for remembrance of the home; Ismail, Elisha and Dhul-Kifl among the outstanding

arabicExcerpts.text: وَوَهَبۡنَا لِدَاوُۥدَ سُلَيۡمَٰنَۚ نِعۡمَ ٱلۡعَبۡدُ إِنَّهُۥٓ أَوَّابٌ
إِذۡ عُرِضَ عَلَيۡهِ بِٱلۡعَشِيِّ ٱلصَّـٰفِنَٰتُ ٱلۡجِيَادُ
فَقَالَ إِنِّيٓ أَحۡبَبۡتُ حُبَّ ٱلۡخَيۡرِ عَن ذِكۡرِ رَبِّي حَتَّىٰ تَوَارَتۡ بِٱلۡحِجَابِ
رُدُّوهَا عَلَيَّۖ فَطَفِقَ مَسۡحَۢا بِٱلسُّوقِ وَٱلۡأَعۡنَاقِ
وَلَقَدۡ فَتَنَّا سُلَيۡمَٰنَ وَأَلۡقَيۡنَا عَلَىٰ كُرۡسِيِّهِۦ جَسَدٗا ثُمَّ أَنَابَ
قَالَ رَبِّ ٱغۡفِرۡ لِي وَهَبۡ لِي مُلۡكٗا لَّا يَنۢبَغِي لِأَحَدٖ مِّنۢ بَعۡدِيٓۖ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلۡوَهَّابُ
فَسَخَّرۡنَا لَهُ ٱلرِّيحَ تَجۡرِي بِأَمۡرِهِۦ رُخَآءً حَيۡثُ أَصَابَ
هَٰذَا عَطَآؤُنَا فَٱمۡنُنۡ أَوۡ أَمۡسِكۡ بِغَيۡرِ حِسَابٖ
وَإِنَّ لَهُۥ عِندَنَا لَزُلۡفَىٰ وَحُسۡنَ مَـَٔابٖ
وَٱذۡكُرۡ عَبۡدَنَآ أَيُّوبَ إِذۡ نَادَىٰ رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنِّي مَسَّنِيَ ٱلشَّيۡطَٰنُ بِنُصۡبٖ وَعَذَابٍ
ٱرۡكُضۡ بِرِجۡلِكَۖ هَٰذَا مُغۡتَسَلُۢ بَارِدٞ وَشَرَابٞ
وَوَهَبۡنَا لَهُۥٓ أَهۡلَهُۥ وَمِثۡلَهُم مَّعَهُمۡ رَحۡمَةٗ مِّنَّا وَذِكۡرَىٰ لِأُوْلِي ٱلۡأَلۡبَٰبِ
وَخُذۡ بِيَدِكَ ضِغۡثٗا فَٱضۡرِب بِّهِۦ وَلَا تَحۡنَثۡۗ إِنَّا وَجَدۡنَٰهُ صَابِرٗاۚ نِّعۡمَ ٱلۡعَبۡدُ إِنَّهُۥٓ أَوَّابٞ
وَٱذۡكُرۡ عِبَٰدَنَآ إِبۡرَٰهِيمَ وَإِسۡحَٰقَ وَيَعۡقُوبَ أُوْلِي ٱلۡأَيۡدِي وَٱلۡأَبۡصَٰرِ
وَٱذۡكُرۡ إِسۡمَٰعِيلَ وَٱلۡيَسَعَ وَذَا ٱلۡكِفۡلِۖ وَكُلّٞ مِّنَ ٱلۡأَخۡيَارِ

mainSubject.label: Sulayman granted to Dawud and praised as an excellent returning servant; the afternoon horse display and his admission of preferring good things over dhikr until sunset; the return order and striking of legs and necks; the throne-body trial followed by his turning; the supplication for forgiveness and an unrepeatable kingdom answered by subjection of wind and of builder and diver devils with others shackled, and licence to give or withhold without account; Ayyub's affliction call answered by the foot-strike spring, restored family doubled as mercy, and the grass-bunch concession preserving his oath while confirming his patience; Ibrahim, Ishaq and Yaqub distinguished by strength, vision and exclusive remembrance of the Hereafter; Ismail, Elisha and Dhul-Kifl counted among the outstanding

commandsAndProhibitions.excerpt: قَالَ رَبِّ ٱغۡفِرۡ لِي وَهَبۡ لِي مُلۡكٗا لَّا يَنۢبَغِي لِأَحَدٖ مِّنۢ بَعۡدِيٓۖ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلۡوَهَّابُ
commandsAndProhibitions.description: My Lord, forgive me and grant me a kingdom such as will not belong to anyone after me; You are the Bestower.

commandsAndProhibitions.excerpt: ٱرۡكُضۡ بِرِجۡلِكَۖ هَٰذَا مُغۡتَسَلُۢ بَارِدٞ وَشَرَابٞ
commandsAndProhibitions.description: Strike the ground with your foot; this is a cool bath and drink.

commandsAndProhibitions.excerpt: وَخُذۡ بِيَدِكَ ضِغۡثٗا فَٱضۡرِب بِّهِۦ وَلَا تَحۡنَثۡۗ إِنَّا وَجَدۡنَٰهُ صَابِرٗاۚ نِّعۡمَ ٱلۡعَبۡدُ إِنَّهُۥٓ أَوَّابٞ
commandsAndProhibitions.description: Take a bunch of grass in your hand and strike with it, and do not break your oath.

commandsAndProhibitions.excerpt: وَٱذۡكُرۡ عِبَٰدَنَآ إِبۡرَٰهِيمَ وَإِسۡحَٰقَ وَيَعۡقُوبَ أُوْلِي ٱلۡأَيۡدِي وَٱلۡأَبۡصَٰرِ
commandsAndProhibitions.description: Remember Our servants Abraham, Isaac and Jacob, possessors of strength and vision.

notes: Wave 6 genuine re-extraction. Boundaries follow the text: P1 ends at the punishment-hastening demand (16) before the patience command opens the Dawud block (17); P2 closes with the blessed-Book reflection verse (29); P3 groups the Sulayman, Ayyub and patriarch remembrance sequence (30-48); P4 is the two-returns contrast ending with the Fire quarrel (49-64); P5 begins with the warner-only declaration and runs through the Adam-Iblees narrative to the closing reminder (65-88).
